notes.manas-2010:p1567:b001:l001: The subject is Chubak’s mount Kögala from 1566:42; the horse’s roaring flight image is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1567:b001:l002: Wolf-tongue describes the lance blade; сыр is the lacquered/painted finish, not a secret.
notes.manas-2010:p1567:b001:l007: Kongurbay is supplied as the subject of the recoil description after Chubak’s blow, to avoid attributing it to Chubak.
notes.manas-2010:p1567:b001:l012: Жаң-жуң is the rank governor-general here, unlike the personal designation Ay Jangjung later. Both six thousand and one thousand retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1567:b001:l014: Kalcha remains Kongurbay’s recurrent epithet, not a newly introduced person; its ethnic or descriptive force is not resolved here.
notes.manas-2010:p1567:b001:l016: Кой көздүү denotes brown, gentle sheep-like eyes; чекир excludes light/pale eyes or flecks. Exact eye-color shade not asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1567:b001:l022: Эгиз is paired/twin-like companionship here, not a claim of biological twinship.
notes.manas-2010:p1567:b001:l028: The dim angular landscape description at 28–30 is abrupt; no missing connective or extra terrain is supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1567:b001:l030: Чай алуучу кен literally a source yielding tea; region is contextual. The unexpected tea reference is retained, not corrected to a battlefield term.
notes.manas-2010:p1568:b001:l013: The active кырып grammatically continues Almambet’s first-person account; slaughtering my people is retained rather than silently changing it to passive suffering.
notes.manas-2010:p1568:b001:l020: Кымбаттуу literally precious/valuable; mighty contextualizes the praise of Beijing’s formidable people, not a material price.
notes.manas-2010:p1568:b001:l026: Жок means absent here, not necessarily dead: Muzburchak and Kökchö return later in the same batch.
notes.manas-2010:p1568:b001:l039: The repeated -басын clauses at 39–1569:02 voice the feared outcome of capture, rendered as negative wishes.
notes.manas-2010:p1569:b001:l001: Айгыр сал is captive men used as breeding stallions, continuing forty girls at 1568:42. The coercive sexual threat and attempted offspring at line02 are retained; compare Yudakhin сал VI6 at https://el-sozduk.kg/сал/.
notes.manas-2010:p1569:b001:l011: Бейле means attend/consider closely, not narrate: Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/бей/. Same root governs heedlessness in line12.
notes.manas-2010:p1569:b001:l016: Printed Чалайыр, a unique spelling in this extraction, is provisionally identified with the Chalyar figure used elsewhere in this witness. The edition glossary 1834:03–13 says reciters personify the four friends as an individual. Compare the inaccessible-place formula under https://el-sozduk.kg/чалыяр/. Identification and scouting sense of чалып remain contextual; raw spelling retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1569:b001:l028: Plural салыштык here and singular салыштым at line30 are both retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1569:b001:l031: Мураска жетпейлик is awkward in this negative exhortation. Rendered contextually as not falling short of the desired outcome, parallel to not dying in regret at line34; literal мурас can mean inheritance. No source emendation claimed.
notes.manas-2010:p1569:b001:l035: Printed Амыз is provisionally намыс, shame/honor, in the repeated retreat formula also seen at 1511:16. Compare намыс кыл- at https://el-sozduk.kg/namys/. Raw Амыз retained; missing initial consonant not silently repaired.
notes.manas-2010:p1570:b001:l001: Капкайда means far away, retained literally; the precise attachment to taking revenge is awkward. The same expression repeats at line17; no invented old grievance or location.
notes.manas-2010:p1570:b001:l005: Жаңырыктын Жар-Кыя treated as Zhangyryk’s Zhar-Kyya, an epic place designation; no modern geographic identification. Жаңырык can also mean echo and жар-кыя cliff.
notes.manas-2010:p1570:b001:l017: Repeated капкайда retained as far away, with бейм suggesting perhaps. See line01 for attachment uncertainty.
notes.manas-2010:p1570:b001:l023: Literal compressed phrase чын аты кымбат тозок retained as hell whose true name is precious. The likely referent is dreaded Beijing, but the evaluative contradiction is not harmonized or replaced with an invented gloss.
notes.manas-2010:p1570:b001:l030: Куурай is a hollow/dry plant stalk used in the seasonal formula; pliant retains былкылдак without asserting a plant species. Exact formula cited by Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/мыйзам/.
notes.manas-2010:p1570:b001:l031: Yudakhin explicitly explains мыйзамдын гүлү as early-autumn floating gossamer and quotes this exact two-line formula: https://el-sozduk.kg/мыйзам/. Edition glossary 1841:16–17 instead gives an autumn-flowering herb/autumn stock; the dictionary’s exact contextual formula is followed, not the legal-law homonym.
notes.manas-2010:p1570:b001:l036: Шор here is saline marsh/ground in a terrain list, contrasted with misfortune at 1568:05. Horse-flank depth retained as stated.
notes.manas-2010:p1571:b001:l001: Printed кол is force/army, although preceding repeated жол refers to the road. The wording is retained; no silent кол→жол emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p1571:b001:l018: Окоро түйгөн interpreted as reins drawn short and knotted; the exact arrangement is not reconstructed.
notes.manas-2010:p1571:b001:l025: White beard turned scarlet is the printed hyperbole; blood or dye is not supplied as its cause.
notes.manas-2010:p1571:b001:l027: Сары изине чөп сал- is relentless close pursuit; literal yellow track and grass are not treated as a separate act of laying grass.
notes.manas-2010:p1571:b001:l031: Kongurbay gathers Chinese in 29–30, then threatens the enemy in 31–36. The implicit object switches; no claim that he plans to slaughter his own assembled Chinese.
notes.manas-2010:p1572:b001:l007: Кабыргасы сөгүлүп is retained as ribs coming apart, a distress image here, not a new medically verified wound.
notes.manas-2010:p1572:b001:l036: Light falling on Beijing during the Flood is retained as epic cosmology, without an external historical claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1573:b001:l001: Printed plural if we die shifts to first-person burial instructions in line02; number shift retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1573:b001:l009: Almambet explicitly orders Sarala slaughtered after his burial; no softening or substitution of another horse.
notes.manas-2010:p1573:b001:l013: Туяксыз literally without a hoof, here no male heir, explicitly contrasted with a daughter. The speaker’s gendered inheritance claim is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1573:b001:l015: Ninety slaughter animals retained without inventing a species.
notes.manas-2010:p1573:b001:l018: Шай provisionally contracted шайык, holy spiritual patrons/saints. No specific named patron inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1573:b001:l023: Thousands and түмөн both retained as thousands upon myriads; no calculated modern army total.
notes.manas-2010:p1573:b001:l026: Тобурчак is a large fine horse fit for war in edition glossary 1842:40; great warhorses avoids an unsupported pure-breed claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1573:b001:l028: Тозогум literally my hell; hardships contextualizes the young child inheriting the speaker’s burdens, not supernatural damnation.
notes.manas-2010:p1573:b001:l032: Ике кый- is the recurring нике marriage formula; Aruuke is to be married to Mazhik, the companion in line31. Printed name Мажик retained, no substitute husband.
notes.manas-2010:p1574:b001:l006: Күлазык means long-keeping journey provisions, mixed with spring water in line07. https://el-sozduk.kg/КҮЛ/.
notes.manas-2010:p1574:b001:l016: Тобокел теңирге places trust in God while undertaking danger; not a promise of survival.
notes.manas-2010:p1574:b001:l034: Күндөй күркүрөп is thunder/weather comparison, rendered storm; the common noun күн is not a new Sun character.
notes.manas-2010:p1574:b001:l036: Seeing in-laws is the printed comparison for Syrgak’s delight at seeing Kongurbay; no actual marriage connection is asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1575:b001:l019: The curse explicitly mentions the father’s grave; retained rather than softened to a generic exclamation.
notes.manas-2010:p1575:b001:l024: Була here valuables/plunder, supported by Yudakhin’s exact Burut-plunder formula at https://el-sozduk.kg/була/, not cotton.
notes.manas-2010:p1575:b001:l028: San remains the epic multitude unit with no invented exact conversion. Кечил is the recurring shaven/Buddhist designation for enemy troops.
notes.manas-2010:p1575:b001:l041: Ок жылан literally arrow-snake, a speed comparison; no zoological species asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1576:b001:l021: Arkesken is the named blade; the immediate subject appears to be Chubak although this blade is associated with Syrgak elsewhere. Weapon ownership is not silently harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p1576:b001:l024: Желдет деген explicitly introduces a champion named Zheldet; the name also means executioner, but is not treated merely as an occupation here.
notes.manas-2010:p1576:b001:l029: Kögala is with Chubak here, but assigned to Kökchö at 1585:23 and 1586:35. Both source assignments retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1577:b001:l003: Camel-sized Kalcha made knucklebone-sized is literal battle hyperbole, not a physical shrinkage explanation.
notes.manas-2010:p1577:b001:l016: Түп этектен ал- literally seize by the very hem, rendered with that clothing image; contextual intent is getting a firm hold for capture/beheading.
notes.manas-2010:p1577:b001:l032: Nine days and nine wounds for Almambet versus seven days and seven wounds for Chubak at 35–37 retained; chronology not reconciled with surrounding time formulas.
notes.manas-2010:p1578:b001:l008: Ит уруш literally dog-fight; the alternating retreat and counterattack described at 13–22 supports running skirmish, rather than an animal fight. Compare Yudakhin уруш referring to ит: https://el-sozduk.kg/уруш/.
notes.manas-2010:p1578:b001:l021: Active pursuing at this line is retained for Chubak’s counterattacks, amid the larger Chinese pursuit; not changed to passive being pursued.
notes.manas-2010:p1578:b001:l026: Repeated ит уруш retained as running skirmish; see line08.
notes.manas-2010:p1578:b001:l034: Those left alive follows the Chinese pursuit and before the three heroes’ arrival. The group referent is not made more specific than the source.
notes.manas-2010:p1579:b001:l008: Same seasonal gossamer formula as 1570:30–31; https://el-sozduk.kg/мыйзам/. The extended fighting season is retained despite shorter counted battles elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p1579:b001:l025: Printed poppies ripened and became grass retained as a seasonal image without a botanical correction.
notes.manas-2010:p1579:b001:l035: Айкаш байла- crosswise tethering retained; exact horse-to-horse arrangement not reconstructed.
notes.manas-2010:p1579:b001:l042: Эгерим strengthens the negative as never; Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/эгер/. No unsupported noun champion, and not a person Egerim.
notes.manas-2010:p1580:b001:l018: Кестирбеген means not circumcised in this Muslim/Chinese opposition; the religious othering is preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1580:b001:l034: Аккаңкы refers to a white/pale saddle frame; no additional saddle material inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1580:b001:l041: Куланөөк is the dawn-light formula, rendered the light grew clear; no exact clock time inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1581:b001:l007: Two customary and two obligatory prayer cycles retained as four dawn cycles; no additional ritual instructions supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1581:b001:l012: Чап олоң is the girth near the horse’s groin, hence rear girth: Yudakhin cited at https://el-sozduk.kg/kolo-9/.
notes.manas-2010:p1581:b001:l014: Каркытта- means adorn with precious metal or figuratively cherish, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/КАРКЫТ/. Adorned their lances follows the literal adornment sense in equipment preparation; the exact application to lances is uncertain, and metal type is not supplied. Not silently changed to кармап/gripped.
notes.manas-2010:p1581:b001:l042: Таш сайынган is the official’s worn rank bead, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/tash-8/. Rendered Chinese officials with rank beads, not stone worshippers.
notes.manas-2010:p1582:b001:l001: Тазаларын means the best/choicest here; Yudakhin’s exact adjacent таш сайынган ... тазасын formula identifies the best officials: https://el-sozduk.kg/ТАЗ/. Not confused with таз bald.
notes.manas-2010:p1582:b001:l011: The one-eyed host is explicitly described as having one eye in the forehead, not merely blind in one eye; mythical detail retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1582:b001:l034: Даңкан means clods thrown from a horse’s hoof, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/даңкан/. Not даңк fame. Shrilling flight is the source image.
notes.manas-2010:p1583:b001:l001: The verse shifts abruptly from Almambet’s participial description to Ay Jangjung charging him. But is a minimal English link; no missing action is fabricated.
notes.manas-2010:p1583:b001:l005: The jacket-edge and golden-belt target is provisionally Almambet’s thought, anticipating his thrust in line09. Source does not explicitly name the thinker until then.
notes.manas-2010:p1583:b001:l013: Була I is fiber/silk/cloth in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/була/. White fiber clumps and horse-head size retained after the shattering lances. Whether this is shredded shaft fiber or textile is not resolved; no specific tassel construction invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1584:b001:l020: Үзүк is the yurt roof-covering felt; the hat comparison is retained without assigning actual roof-felt construction.
notes.manas-2010:p1584:b001:l026: Singular I shall fight/rescue occurs in the collective forty-companion speech; grammatical number retained rather than rewritten entirely as we.
notes.manas-2010:p1585:b001:l017: Караан кылып чорону takes the companions as support grammatically. They are also coming to aid the battle; not silently reversed to being the companions’ support.
notes.manas-2010:p1585:b001:l023: Kögala explicitly assigned to Kökchö, although Chubak has it at 1576:29. Repeated contradictory allocation retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1586:b001:l012: Жайсаң rendered noble, a Chinese/Manchu elite title here, not a new personal name. Forty is repeated at 18–19.
notes.manas-2010:p1586:b001:l024: Зубун-зубун conveys successive groups/multitudes; troop upon troop avoids an unsupported numeric unit conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p1586:b001:l034: Өлүп турат literally stands dying, here anguish while seeing Kökchö captured; the contextual dying of anguish avoids asserting Muzburchak has died before subsequent action.
notes.manas-2010:p1586:b001:l035: Kökchö’s Kögala explicitly repeated; see 1585:23 and the different Chubak association at 1576:29.
notes.manas-2010:p1586:b001:l042: Көк бөрү тарт- is the carcass-pulling game applied to captive Kökchö. The violent comparison is translated explicitly; he is not said to be already dead.
